negative_findings.description: Czech PSPs and gateways (ComGate, GoPay, Besteron) are private companies and are not contracting authorities; targeted cs queries for 'výběrové řízení', 'poptávkové řízení' and 'dodavatel' on these actors returned only merchant-facing marketing and gateway-comparison content, no procurement notices.
negative_findings.result_summary: No supplier-selection notices found on or about ComGate/GoPay; only product comparison pages and integration docs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell hypothesis: payments-side vendor selection in CZ is invisible to public registers and must be inferred from press releases, corporate filings and integration/changelog evidence.

negative_findings.description: Besteron (SK-origin gateway active in CZ) did not surface in any of the cs searches run; no corporate press or partner page was located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A named cell actor is currently uncovered; its partner/bank relationships are unmapped.

negative_findings.description: No Visa Czech-language newsroom or CZ-specific Visa press index was located; searches surfaced only Mastercard's cs-cz newsroom. Visa CZ announcements appear to route through the pan-European English newsroom or partner banks' press pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Mastercard has a cs-cz release index; Visa equivalent not found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Half the card-scheme rule-setter coverage for the cell lacks a local-language primary channel and must be reached indirectly.

negative_findings.description: No CERTIS- or instant-payments-specific supplier/tender document was found via search; ČNB pages describe rules and participants but searches did not reach an individual CERTIS technology contract notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: CERTIS supplier identity not established from open search in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The core national rail's vendor chain remains unmapped; requires direct enumeration of ezak.cnb.cz and registr smluv rather than search engines.

negative_findings.description: SBK's web presence is split across two domains (bankovnikarty.cz and bankovni-karty.cz) with an apparently dated structure; which is canonical and whether member-only material exists was not established.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two candidate domains, canonical one unresolved; no fetch attempted to verify.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Risk of collecting from a stale mirror and missing current member/vendor lists.

coverage_gaps.description: Acquirer/PSP layer is only partially mapped: Besteron, Monri/Payten-type regional processors, Nexi/Nets footprint in CZ, and terminal-estate vendors were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full ČNB JERRS list of payment institutions and e-money institutions for CZ, then build a per-actor source card from corporate site + Sbírka listin.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level tender channel (TED) was not searched for CZ payments notices, and neither was the ČNB free-information (Act 106/1999) disclosure archive, which sometimes discloses supplier names withheld elsewhere.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add TED with CZ + payments CPV filters, and crawl the ČNB '106' disclosure index as a low-volume but high-signal source.

coverage_gaps.description: Scheme certification and partner programmes (Mastercard/Visa vendor certification, tokenisation service providers, 3DS ACS vendors approved for CZ issuers) have no located source at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Target scheme global vendor/partner directories and certified-product lists, then filter to entities with CZ presence; treat as indirect evidence of local vendor selection.

coverage_gaps.description: Local-language coverage was achieved for registers, associations and PSPs, but no Czech-language terminology was found or used for scheme certification concepts (certifikace akceptačního zařízení, ACS/3DS vendor approval).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a cs glossary for card certification terms from SBK materials and terminal-vendor documentation before the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched; all entries rest on search-result metadata and snippets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness/verification pass over every candidate URL, paying special attention to the JERRS session-gated entry point and the two SBK domains.

brief: The CZ payments-ecosystem cell splits cleanly into two source regimes. The public regime — ČNB's E-ZAK profile, VVZ/NEN, registr smluv, and the Hlídač státu aggregator over them — is well-instrumented and covers only the central bank and state bodies buying payment acceptance; CERTIS and instant-payment rules themselves are published authoritatively by ČNB but the supplier chain behind them was not reachable by search alone. The private regime — Bank iD, SBK, ČBA/COBS, Global Payments, Worldline, Comgate, GoPay, Twisto and the card schemes — never issues public notices, so vendor selection has to be reconstructed indirectly from corporate press rooms, partner directories, Sbírka listin filings, GitHub standard contributions and CZ trade press (Lupa, Měšec, Bankovnipoplatky). Mastercard maintains a Czech-language newsroom; no Visa CZ equivalent was found, and Besteron plus the scheme certification layer remain entirely uncovered.
